notes: Group: Rebel Cell. FULL portrait site overlay printed sideways that RENAMES the site: bars '◊ REBEL CELL - PERIMETER' (hollow ◊, red on Light bar, white on Dark bar). Art window blank. Light half (right) = game_text, Dark half (left) = dark_text. One blue saber, one red saber. Icon boxes both bars, outermost first: planet, exterior; no scomp. Bottom margin: VS15 set sphere only → icons []. INLINE ICON after 'Your': a small pale grey/silver sphere with dark rim — rendered from the PDF at 2400 dpi and matched to the Hoth expansion icon (assets/icons/set-hoth-grainy.png / Game Aid Feb 2024 'Hoth') → {set:hoth} (Hoth's artillery weapons: Anti-Infantry Battery, Atgar Laser Cannon, etc.); the stub drops the icon. The VB4 reissue prints the same grey disc. CHANGES vs printed Tatooine: Tosche Station (Special Edition, unique •; Light 'You generate +X Force here, where X = power of your highest forfeit character here.' / Dark 'If you occupy, opponent’s Tosche Station game text is canceled.'): renamed ◊, both texts replaced. Stub text otherwise matches. Base 490×350 only; copyright SE 1998 read off the scan. Modern: VB4-L-rebelcellperimeter-pre.gif (Virtual Block 4; art only).
